tools.name: find_peptide_sources
tools.description: Vendors that carry a peptide, tiered by PepEvolution COA audit status. `vendors` lists only vendors whose COAs are verified real, batch-matched, and from a named independent lab, ranked by Source Match (vendor grade × batch-COA freshness; ties resolve to the non-affiliate). `unaudited_vendors` publi

tools.name: check_vendor
tools.description: PepEvolution's independent audit of a research-peptide vendor: PepScore grade + band, COA status, audit summary, and buy link for graded vendors; the COA-audit record (status, risk flags) for vendors audited but not graded; or a clear "not evaluated". Strict matching: generic words like "peptides" o

tools.name: list_verified_vendors
tools.description: Every PepEvolution-graded research-peptide vendor, sorted by PepScore desc. On a score tie the non-affiliate ranks first. Each entry carries grade + band, COA status, buy link, coupon, and is_affiliate.

tools.name: get_compound_grade
tools.description: A peptide's PepScore grade: score, band, category, one-liner, last_graded, and cite_url.

tools.name: get_peptide_price
tools.description: Research-vendor pricing from the PepEvolution price index: median/p25/p75 $/mg, vendor_count, last_scraped, and cite_url.

tools.name: get_dosing_guide
tools.description: Doses used in published research for a peptide, each row with route, caveats, and citations, plus regulatory status, evidence summary, pharmacology, safety notes, and a worked reconstitution example. tools.name: calculate_reconstitution
tools.description: Reconstitution arithmetic: given vial size (mg), bacteriostatic water added (mL), and a dose, returns concentration, dose volume in mL, units on a U-100 insulin syringe, and doses per vial. Pure math; it does not judge whether a dose is appropriate.
